# The Pitcher's Mitt's lighter gravity lasts one step for a Rock and for good for a Jar (851-3442,
# docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip quirks/mitt-gravity-one-step. A staged scene (written by wiki-clips

# load-level menu (240), and plays the scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) has the Mitt (g) to
# his left, a Rock (r) to his right and a Jar (j) by the left wall:

# He picks up the Mitt (259), then the Rock (283), and throws it standing, holding neither up nor down (301): it
# leaves at 14 px a step across and 0.4 up, and scrUseItem sets its myGrav to 0.1. oItem's step adds the 0.1
# (yVel -0.3, 301) and then puts myGrav back to 0.6, as it does on every step out of lava, so the next step adds
# 0.6 (yVel 0.3, 302): the Rock is on the floor by 305 (xVel 14 -> 4.2) and stops at 310. He walks back, picks
# up the Jar (345) and throws it the same way (361). oJar's step replaces oItem's and only sets myGrav in lava,
# so the Jar keeps 0.1: yVel -0.3, -0.2, -0.1, ... (361-372), 12 steps flat across the room before it lands
# (373), and still 0.1 when it lies still (378 on).
# story: hasMitt=1@259..259 held=oRock@283 oRock.yVel<-0.29@301..301 oRock.yVel>0.29@302..302
# story: oRock.xVel<5@305..305 held=oJar@345 oJar.myGrav=0.1@361..361 !oJar.myGrav>0.1@361.. oJar.xVel<5@373..373
